Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
800 AM EDT Mon Oct 12 2026

For the North Atlantic...Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of America:

Eastern Tropical Atlantic:
An elongated area of low pressure centered a few hundred miles west 
of the Cabo Verde Islands continues to produce a large but 
disorganized area of showers and thunderstorms, which are occurring 
on the east side of the low, extending toward the westernmost Cabo 
Verde Islands.  Environmental conditions appear, at best, marginally 
conducive for any development of this system during the next day or 
two before upper-level winds become too strong for any further 
development.  Regardless, heavy rainfall is expected to continue for 
the next day or two across western portions of the Cabo Verde 
Islands, and some flooding is possible there as the system moves 
slowly northward to north-northwestward.
* Formation chance through 48 hours...low...20 percent.
* Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.
